hypothesis: Mutashabihat swaps (عليه↔عليهما in the as-Saffat refrains, 26:141, 7:66) are missed because the checker judges them as string end-edits, where held-sound and waqf tolerances lend neighbouring sounds to the suffix. Decode the anchored stretch on the posteriors against a graph of the written phrase plus every mushaf parallel-phrase path. Calibrate the switch penalty on real recitations of those parallel verses by gold-excluded readers. Predict checker -3, overall -3.
